senses.sense_definition: op een draf (snel lopen of rustig rennen) naderen of ergens naartoe gaan, vaak gezegd van paarden of mensen

examples.text: Na een korte pauze liet de ruiter zijn paard weer rustig <w>aandraven</w> op de zandweg.

target_lang_translations.en: After a short break, the rider let his horse <w>trot up</w> quietly on the dirt road again.

examples.text: De sporters moesten achter hun trainer <w>aandraven</w> tijdens de warming-up in het park.

target_lang_translations.en: The athletes had to <w>jog along</w> behind their trainer during the warm-up in the park.

target_lang_definitions.en: To approach or move towards a place at a trot (a pace between walking and running), often said of horses or people.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: approaching at a steady, rhythmic pace
moving towards a location at a trot
following or moving at a slow run
